The '''Windchapped Ridge''' was the name given to the ridge that lay west of [[Frostbite Lake]] in the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Frostbite Redoubt]] was located under the ridge, and had an entrance on the west side of the ridge, while the [[Ice Behemoth Cave]] was located further underground and could be reached through an entrance on the eastern underside of the ridge. The [[Frozen Footpath]] ran to the west and south of the ridge, linking [[Dorn Base]] to the west with the [[Forward Bunker]] to the south.
